:::: {.column-screen-inset} :::: {style="background-color: #FFF68F;text-align: center"} # [Data Wrangling]{style="color:#EED2EE;"} ``{=html} ::: :::: ## Load Data from Github ```{.python .cell-code code-fold="false"} # load modules import numpy as np import pandas as pd ``` ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # load data data = pd.read_csv("C:/Users/sultanov/Documents/pop_de_2014-2024.csv", sep=";") data.head() print(f"\nDataShape: {data.shape}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Stichtag Bundesland Altersjahre männlich weiblich #> 0 31.12.2014 Baden-Württemberg unter 1 Jahr 49584 46727 #> 1 31.12.2014 Baden-Württemberg 1-Jährige 48446 45680 #> 2 31.12.2014 Baden-Württemberg 2-Jährige 47685 45359 #> 3 31.12.2014 Baden-Württemberg 3-Jährige 47055 44985 #> 4 31.12.2014 Baden-Württemberg 4-Jährige 48725 46044 #> #> DataShape: (16016, 5) ``` ::: ::: ## Screening data and handle missing values ### show data type and futures ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} data.info() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> #> RangeIndex: 16016 entries, 0 to 16015 #> Data columns (total 5 columns): #> # Column Non-Null Count Dtype #> --- ------ -------------- ----- #> 0 Stichtag 4467 non-null object #> 1 Bundesland 4586 non-null object #> 2 Altersjahre 16016 non-null object #> 3 männlich 16016 non-null int64 #> 4 weiblich 16016 non-null int64 #> dtypes: int64(2), object(3) #> memory usage: 625.8+ KB ``` ::: ::: ### show missing values ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} data.isnull().sum() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Stichtag 11549 #> Bundesland 11430 #> Altersjahre 0 #> männlich 0 #> weiblich 0 #> dtype: int64 ``` ::: ::: ### fill `NAs` We have 2 columns wit missing values and can fill them with the method `ffill` ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} data[["Stichtag", "Bundesland"]] = data[["Stichtag", "Bundesland"]].fillna(method = "ffill") data.isnull().sum() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Stichtag 0 #> Bundesland 0 #> Altersjahre 0 #> männlich 0 #> weiblich 0 #> dtype: int64 ``` ::: ::: ### unify the values and rename the column names Colum `Stichtag`:
*31.12.2014 -> 2014*
*31.12.2021 -> 2021* ...
Column `Altersjahre`:
*unter 1 Jahr -> 1*
*36-Jährige -> 36*
*90 Jahre und mehr -> 90* ... ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # display data from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML # col "Stichtag" = 31.12.2014 -> 2014 ... data["Stichtag"] = data["Stichtag"].apply(lambda x: x[6:]) # col "Altersjahre" = unter 1 Jahr -> 1-Jährige # col "Altersjahre" = 90 Jahre und mehr -> 90-Jährige dict = {"unter 1 Jahr":"1-Jährige", "90 Jahre und mehr":"90-Jährige"} data["Altersjahre"] = data["Altersjahre"].replace(dict) # col "Altersjahre" = split only numbers data["Altersjahre"] = data["Altersjahre"].str.split("-").str[0] data.sample(10) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Stichtag Bundesland Altersjahre männlich weiblich #> 9335 2020 Hessen 53 51974 51431 #> 7325 2019 Baden-Württemberg 45 66073 66228 #> 435 2014 Bremen 71 3362 3629 #> 5548 2017 Sachsen 88 5495 11753 #> 6799 2018 Rheinland-Pfalz 65 25417 26980 #> 9536 2020 Niedersachsen 72 38879 42110 #> 9441 2020 Mecklenburg-Vorpommern 68 11712 12964 #> 5769 2017 Thüringen 36 14192 12500 #> 15438 2024 Nordrhein-Westfalen 59 147323 148153 #> 13561 2023 Hamburg 2 9773 9265 ``` ::: ::: ### rename the column names ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # rename columns newcols = { "Stichtag":"year", "Bundesland":"bundesland", "Altersjahre":"age", "männlich":"male", "weiblich":"female" } data.rename(columns = newcols, inplace = True) # column year to integer data["age"] = data["age"].astype(int) data.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> year bundesland age male female #> 0 2014 Baden-Württemberg 1 49584 46727 #> 1 2014 Baden-Württemberg 1 48446 45680 #> 2 2014 Baden-Württemberg 2 47685 45359 #> 3 2014 Baden-Württemberg 3 47055 44985 #> 4 2014 Baden-Württemberg 4 48725 46044 ``` ::: ::: ### group data (column = age) into categories ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # remove column bundesland df = data.drop("bundesland", axis = 1) # group by year, age, sum by bundesland df = df.groupby(["year", "age"], as_index =False).sum() bins = [0, 17, 59, 90] lbls_gr = ["0-17", "18-59", "60+" ] age_gr = df.groupby("year")[["age"]].transform(lambda x: pd.cut(x, bins = bins, labels = lbls_gr).astype(str)) df["age_grouped"] = age_gr df.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> year age male female age_grouped #> 0 2014 1 724578 687756 0-17 #> 1 2014 2 356316 338053 0-17 #> 2 2014 3 349198 331911 0-17 #> 3 2014 4 357848 340751 0-17 #> 4 2014 5 353123 334728 0-17 ``` ::: ::: ### new colum with categorical name from grouped column ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} lbls_cat = {"0-17":"Kids & Jugend", "18-59":"Erwachsene", "60+":"Senioren"} df["age_cat"] = df["age_grouped"].map(lbls_cat) df.sample(10) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> year age male female age_grouped age_cat #> 108 2015 19 458792 413450 18-59 Erwachsene #> 595 2020 56 704793 697779 18-59 Erwachsene #> 866 2023 57 681024 677785 18-59 Erwachsene #> 235 2016 56 646119 647001 18-59 Erwachsene #> 11 2014 12 376432 356637 0-17 Kids & Jugend #> 587 2020 48 521005 517210 18-59 Erwachsene #> 111 2015 22 479967 438088 18-59 Erwachsene #> 457 2019 8 372873 352934 0-17 Kids & Jugend #> 364 2018 5 380099 359630 0-17 Kids & Jugend #> 117 2015 28 559651 517800 18-59 Erwachsene ``` ::: ::: ### final data frame: ready to go! ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} df_py = df.drop("age", axis = 1).groupby(["year", "age_grouped", "age_cat"], as_index = False).sum() # show data frame Markdown(df_py.head(8).to_markdown(index = False)) #df_py.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | year | age_grouped | age_cat | male | female | |-------:|:--------------|:--------------|---------:|---------:| | 2014 | 0-17 | Kids & Jugend | 6730760 | 6381260 | | 2014 | 18-59 | Erwachsene | 23218843 | 22624986 | | 2014 | 60+ | Senioren | 9885854 | 12355834 | | 2015 | 0-17 | Kids & Jugend | 6865197 | 6460480 | | 2015 | 18-59 | Erwachsene | 23614627 | 22733146 | | 2015 | 60+ | Senioren | 10034299 | 12467935 | | 2016 | 0-17 | Kids & Jugend | 6943513 | 6526749 | | 2016 | 18-59 | Erwachsene | 23562105 | 22698301 | ::: ::: :::: {.column-screen-inset} :::: {style="background-color: #FFF68F;text-align: center"} # [Data Visualizing]{style="color:#EED2EE;"} ``{=html} ::: :::: ### Prepare data ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # pivot to long df_py_pv = pd.melt( df_py, # data id_vars = ["year", "age_grouped", "age_cat"], # not to shape value_vars = ["male", "female"], # to shape var_name = "gender", # colname for reshaped vars value_name = "cnts" # colname for reshaped values ) # round colum cnts df_py_pv["cnts"] = df_py_pv["cnts"].map(lambda x: round(x/1000000,2)) # remove colum year df_py_pv = df_py_pv[df_py_pv["year"] == "2024"].drop("year", axis = 1) # ordered categories (levels in R) agegroup = ["0-17", "18-59", "60+"] agecat = ["Kids & Jugend", "Erwachsene", "Senioren"] df_py_pv["age_grouped"] = pd.Categorical(df_py_pv["age_grouped"], categories = agegroup, ordered = True) df_py_pv["age_cat"] = pd.Categorical(df_py_pv["age_cat"], categories = agecat, ordered = True) # sort df_py_pl = df_py_pv.sort_values(["age_cat", "cnts"], ascending=[True, False]) df_py_pv.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> age_grouped age_cat gender cnts #> 30 0-17 Kids & Jugend male 7.18 #> 31 18-59 Erwachsene male 22.47 #> 32 60+ Senioren male 11.59 #> 63 0-17 Kids & Jugend female 6.79 #> 64 18-59 Erwachsene female 21.64 ``` ::: ::: ### Plotting data frame ::: {.cell} ```{.python .cell-code} # load moduls import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from highlight_text import fig_text # pivot pivot_df = df_py_pl.pivot(index="age_cat", columns="gender", values="cnts") # totals for eag category totals = pivot_df.sum(axis=1) # for second label (age grouped: 0-17,..) d = df_py_pl.pivot(index=["age_cat", "age_grouped"], columns="gender", values="cnts") #d.index[0][1] # plot fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5)) bar_width = 0.25 x = np.arange(len(pivot_df.index)) colors = ["#E85252", "#6689C6"] # total bar ax.bar(x, totals, width=bar_width * 2.5, color="#E0E0E0", zorder=0) for i, sub_cat in enumerate(pivot_df.columns): values = pivot_df[sub_cat] ax.bar( x + (i - 0.5) * bar_width, values, width=bar_width, zorder=1, color=colors[i], ) for j, val in enumerate(values): ax.text( x[j] + (i - 0.5) * bar_width, val + 1, f"{val:.2f}M", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8, ) for i, total in enumerate(totals): ax.text( x[i], total + 1, f"Altersgruppe ({d.index[i][1]})\n{total:.2f}M", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, color="#555555", ) ax.set_xticks(x) ax.set_xticklabels(pivot_df.index) ax.set_yticks(list(range(0, 51, 10))) ax.spines[["top", "right", "bottom"]].set_visible(False) ax.tick_params(axis="x", size=0, pad=10) ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8) fig.text(x=0.091, y=0.91, s="Bevölkerung in Deutschland nach Altersgruppen bei Geschlecht in M=Mln., 2024", size=11) fig_text( x=0.14, y=0.89, s=" ", highlight_textprops=[ {"color": colors[0]}, {"color": colors[1]}, ], ) plt.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](popde_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: :::: {.column-screen} :::: {style="background-color: lightcyan;text-align: center"} # [Data Visualizing]{style="color:#EED2EE;"} ``{=html} ::: :::: ### Prepare data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # use pandas dataframe df df_r <- py$df_py #unique(df_r$age_cat) # Ensure age_grouped and age_cat is a factor with the desired order (0-13,14-17,18-59,60+) df_r$age_grouped <- factor(df_r$age_grouped, levels = c("0-17", "18-59", "60+")) df_r$age_cat <- factor( df_r$age_cat, levels = c("Kids & Jugend", "Erwachsene", "Senioren")) head(df_r) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> year age_grouped age_cat male female #> 1 2014 0-17 Kids & Jugend 6730760 6381260 #> 2 2014 18-59 Erwachsene 23218843 22624986 #> 3 2014 60+ Senioren 9885854 12355834 #> 4 2015 0-17 Kids & Jugend 6865197 6460480 #> 5 2015 18-59 Erwachsene 23614627 22733146 #> 6 2015 60+ Senioren 10034299 12467935 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # pivot long mln <- 1000000 df_pv <- df_r|> #pivot_longer( # cols = !c(year, age_grouped, age_cat), # names_to = "gender", # values_to = "cnts" #) |> rowwise() |> mutate(total = sum(male, female)) |> pivot_longer(!c(year, age_grouped, age_cat, total), names_to = "gender", values_to = "cnts") |> mutate( total = round(total/mln, digits = 2), cnts = round(cnts/mln, digits = 2), year = as.integer(year), gender = factor(gender, levels = c("female", "male")) ) rmarkdown::paged_table(head(df_pv, 10)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Plotting data frame ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} gg_plt <- df_pv |> filter(year == 2024) |> ggplot()+ # BEGINN ============================================================================ # Layer 1: Grey background with total values per agegroup ===================================== geom_col( aes(x = age_cat, y = total/2), # sonst gibt dopplt wert fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8 ) + # Layer 2: Dodged bars for gender ============================================================= geom_col( aes(x = age_cat, y = cnts, fill = gender), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), # Dodge bars side-by-side width = 0.7 ) + # Layer 3: Labels for individual gender bars (Value M) ======================================== geom_text( aes(x = age_cat, y = cnts, label = paste(as.character(round(cnts, digits = 2)), "M"), group = gender), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), # Match dodging of bars vjust = -0.5, # Position label above the bar size = 3.3, # Adjust text size family = "sans" ) + # Layer 4: Labels for total age group (Value M) =============================================== geom_text( #data = filter(gender_total, year == 2024), aes(x = age_cat, y = total, label = paste(as.character(round(total, digits = 2)), "M")), vjust = -0.8, # Position above the grey bar, adjust vertical position size = 3.7, # Adjust text size fontface = "bold", family = "sans", color = "gray40" ) + # Layer 5: Labels for agegroup (0-17, ..., 60+) =============================================== geom_text( aes(x = age_cat, y = total, label = paste("Altersgruppe (", as.character(age_grouped), ")")), # label is character vjust = -2.9, size = 4.0, # fontface = "bold", family = "sans", color = "gray45" ) + # Plot-, Axistitle ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- labs( title = "Bevölkerung in Deutschland nach Altersgruppen bei Geschlecht in M = Mln., 2024", caption = social_caption, x = NULL, y = NULL) + # Adjust y-axis limits to provide space for labels above the bars ----------------------------- scale_y_continuous( limits = c(0, max(df_pv$total) * 1.1), # ~35% extra space at top expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) + # Start y-axis at 0 # Customize the theme ========================================================================= theme( # Plot Title / Caption Style -------------------------------------------------------------- plot.title = element_text( color = "blue4", hjust = 0, # Left-align title face = "bold", # Bold title text size = 14, # Title font size margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5)), # Margin below title plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(size=12, hjust = 0.5), # Legend Style ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- legend.position = "top", # Legend at the top legend.justification = "left", # Left-align legend items legend.title = element_blank(), # No legend title legend.text = element_text(size = 11), # Legend text size legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), # Size of color keys in legend legend.margin = margin(b = -5), # Reduce space below legend legend.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"), # Axis line / plot&panel background ------------------------------------------------------ plot.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"), axis.text.y = element_blank(), # y axis label blank axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), # - in axis blank axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), # - in axis blank axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "darkslategray"), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "gray") ) # END ===================================================================================== gg_plt ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](popde_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ### Animated plot ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g_anm <- g_plt + transition_states(year, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1, wrap = FALSE) anmt <- animate( g_anm, duration = 10, start_pause = 5, end_pause = 5, renderer = gifski_renderer()) anmt ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](popde_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-20-1.gif) ::: :::
